old: Per-second billing with no free compute allowance: CNY 0.00003 per vCPU per second, which the page restates as CNY 0.108 per vCPU per hour, range 1 to 8 cores; CNY 0.000015 per GiB per second, or CNY 0.054 per GiB per hour, 512 MiB to 8192 MiB in 512 MiB steps. new: Per-second billing with no free compute allowance. Domestic region China (Yangzhou 1), current prices from 19 November 2026: CNY 0.00002 per vCPU per second (CNY 0.072 per vCPU-hour) and CNY 0.00001 per GiB per second (CNY 0.036 per GiB-hour), 1 to 8 cores and 512 MiB to 8192 MiB in 512 MiB steps. Overseas region US (Dallas 1): CNY 0.0000405 per vCPU per second (CNY 0.1458 per vCPU-hour) and CNY 0.00002025 per GiB per second (CNY 0.0729 per GiB-hour). Each sandbox gets 20 GiB of local disk free. Persistent storage includes 10 GiB per account per month free, then CNY 0.000145 per GiB-hour in the domestic region or CNY 0.00019575 per GiB-hour in the overseas region. Network traffic is not billed separately. A 2 vCPU / 2 GiB sandbox running 8 hours a day with 15 GiB persistent storage is about CNY 1.75 per day by the page's worked example.
